source.symbol: Test kind loader, transforms and task-defaults
source.validation: Exact public Git source at the fixed comparison revision. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
loader: comm_taskgraph.loader.test:loader

kind-dependencies:
    - build
    - build-mac-signing
    - build-signing
    - repackage-signing-shippable-l10n-msix
    - repackage-signing-msix
    - fetch
    - toolchain

transforms:
    - comm_taskgraph.transforms.enterprise:remove_enterprise_tests
    - comm_taskgraph.transforms.tests:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.test:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.job:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms

tasks-from:
    - compiled.yml
    - marionette.yml
    - tests.yml

# These apply to all included test yml files listed in tasks-from
task-defaults:
    run-on-repo-type: ["hg", "git"]
    attributes:
        retrigger: true
    use-python: system
    use-uv: false
    optimization:
        by-test-platform:
            .*-tsan.*/opt:
                skip-unless-backstop: null
            .*-asan.*/opt:
                skip-unless-backstop: null
            default:
                never: null
    docker-image: {in-tree: ubuntu2404-test}
